name: e-zer0-personal
description: Connect ChatGPT to your personal e-zer0 email bridge using OAuth and explicit mailbox permissions.

interface.longDescription: Search, read, and manage email through your personal e-zer0 instance. Connect with OAuth and select the mailboxes this client may access on the e-zer0 consent page.
interface.defaultPrompt: List the email accounts I have permitted this e-zer0 connection to access.
